item.title: Monitoring CNV Upgrade Progress
item.description: Monitor operator status, VM migrations, and verify all workloads are updated. Upgrade Phases Subscription update — OLM pulls new CSV Operator update — CNV operator pods restart Workload update — VMs live-migrated to new virt-launcher pods Completion — All components updated, no outdated workloads Monitoring Commands 1. Check Subscription Status oc get subscription kubevirt-hyperconverged -n openshift-cnv -o yaml Key fields:
